purpose: Clear the parent Level 2 G0 availability, entitlement, schema-discovery, symbology, billable-size, and exact-cost gate for four mechanically selected smoke cases without requesting market data.

authorization.source: user authorization on 2026-08-20 to use DATABENTO_API_KEY and conserve the reported new-user credits
authorization.reported_credit_expiry: six months after account creation; exact account-creation date not stored
authorization.budget_rule: A future smoke acquisition must stop for review when the conservative five-schema quote exceeds 10 percent of the reported credit. This quote artifact never authorizes a download.

provider.secret_scope: quote workflow step only; never persisted

quote_windows.alignment: all starts and ends are exact ten-minute boundaries
quote_windows.reason: The MBO quote includes the provider day start needed to investigate complete initial state. The other strategy-window schemas cover and pad the registered 06:55-10:05 New York interval.

pass_condition: All four point-in-time symbols resolve; XNAS.ITCH exposes all five schemas and metadata; all 20 exact quote rows complete; their conservative sum is at most 12.50 USD; and no market-data endpoint is called.
failure_action: Persist only the sanitized metadata failure, spend no credit, request no market data, and do not advance to schema integrity or reconstruction.
claim_boundary: A successful quote proves only bounded availability and price, not data integrity or strategy value.
XNAS.ITCH remains single-venue Nasdaq depth rather than consolidated national Level 2.
The four retrospective smoke cases cannot fit a threshold or support a profitability claim.
No Databento record, raw response containing credentials, paper order, or live order may be persisted by this contract.
